page.layout: One block of running text in the centre of the page. No printed margin notes: the marks in the right margin are handwriting, and the strip at the left edge is the neighbouring page. Running head at the top, signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: statem ac subtilitatem, cum admiranda illa siderum republica, aufu supra hominem arduo, in terram quasi deduxerint Natura venatores, aeternumque libris felicioribus condiderint. Aufu pari, successu non impari, sub limatae mentes per aeris profunditatem iter ad naturale domicilium relegerunt, admissis in tantae felicitatis societatem etiam corporibus, quibus cum montium ardua, vallium lubrica, camporum glebosa, profunda marium, intima terrarum & syluarum abdita perreptarunt; ne quod uspiam in aere, igne, aqua, terra, meteoris, metallis, plantis & animantibus diuinitatis esset vestigium, quod solicita & curiosa indagine repertum oculis non usurparent, manibusque palparent.

Primos mortalium, si Patriarchas excepe-ris, Chaldæos, aliofque Orientis populos peregrinationis hujusce duces habemus; non tantum quod loci opportunitas, patenti-bus illic late campis, & noctibus serenitate perpetua siderali contemplationi nite-scentibus, ad studij hujus amoenitatem & divinitatem animos prolectaret, sed quod felicibus Paridisi glebis, quæ prima omnis sapientiæ & felicitatis fuere incunabula, vici-

page.notes: Right margin: handwritten ink marks (ignored as handwriting). Left edge: text of the neighbouring page (ignored). Small printed-looking marks "ı." beside "siderali" and "ıı." beside "quod" in the right margin are too faint to read with certainty and are not transcribed. "prolectaret" is read from a slightly blurred word and may be "prolectaret" or similar; treat with caution.
